description: Plan de Prévention des Risques Naturels - PORT-LOUIS 97 122 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by karugeo.fr. Departmental digital database of natural risk (multi-hazard) prevention plans. Only approved PPRNs whose numerical data have been validated by the natural hazards department of the energy waste risks department (RED) of the DEAL, and then structured according to the internal specifications of the DEAL are integrated into the departmental database. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Natural Risk Prevention Plan - PORT-LOUIS 97 122" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Données vecteur. The listing shows 2011-07-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
